<includeonly>{{
#if: {{{3| }}} 
| <!-- If there is a 3rd parameter, don't round off -->
    {{significant figures | 
        {{{1|0}}} | 
        {{#if: {{{2| }}} | 
            {{{2}}} | 
            {{significant figures | {{{1|0}}} }} 
        }}
    }} ({{significant figures | 
        {{#expr: {{{1|0}}} * 0.386102 }} | 
        {{#if: {{{2| }}} | 
            {{{2}}} | 
            {{significant figures | {{{1|0}}} }} 
        }}
    }}) 
| <!-- No or blank 3rd parameter, round off -->
    {{significant figures | 
        {{round | {{{1|0}}} }} | 
        {{#if: {{{2| }}} | 
            {{{2}}} | 
            {{significant figures | {{round | {{{1|0}}} }} }} 
        }}
    }} ({{significant figures | 
        {{round | {{#expr: {{{1|0}}} * 0.386102 }} }} | 
        {{#if: {{{2| }}} | 
            {{{2}}} | {{min |
                {{significant figures | {{round | {{{1|0}}} }} }} |
                {{significant figures | {{round | {{#expr: {{{1|0}}} * 0.386102 }} }} }} 
            }}
        }}
    }}) 
}}</includeonly><noinclude>
{{documentation}}
</noinclude>
